title: AU: simplify confusing shop-screen words in PRs #232–#261
public_pr_body:
Review of all 30 PR snapshot diffs is recorded with full heads in the handover. Fixes only confusing screen/server-message wording in accounting, AI, reminder settings and email editing; no behavior or stored-text changes.

Validation: 90 affected tests pass (64 accounting/chase/AI plus 26 editor/integration); typecheck and explicit changed-code lint pass. One existing wording assertion updated to preserve the same refusal-state check. Operator visual/browser checks remain unrun.

Committed job handover included. Draft only, no Ready label, production SQL, main merge or deployment. Builder 3 CM/CN/CO/CP/CQ untouched. Build/test deadline 6 November; conditional go-live 12 November 2026.
